answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can vouch for newcomers, with the stake slashed if a vouched identity cheats. A single attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund each one, so the cost scales with the attack instead of staying flat. Like a harbor that only shelters ships which pay their berth, the ledger admits identities at dawn of each epoch and sheds them at their nadir when the stake is gone — sybils become expensive, not free.
